name: UnsavedNavigationGuard
purpose: A router-neutral adapter for explicitly guarded navigation and a best-effort unload warning.
description: Router-neutral adapter. It does not intercept links, history changes, or router APIs by itself.

props.name: beforeUnload
props.description: Browser close/reload prompt only. Browsers choose the text and may suppress it.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: Called after permission to leave, before the requested navigation. May reject to keep the dialog open.

guidance.overview: A router-neutral adapter for explicitly guarded navigation and a best-effort unload warning.
usage: Route relevant navigation through requestNavigation(() => router.navigate(...)).
Keep dirty state and draft recovery in the host.
Use onDiscard for explicit cleanup; make callbacks safe to retry.
accessibility: Use meaningful names and preserve the shared control keyboard behavior.
Verify the real host integration, including focus and recovery, with keyboard and assistive technology.
intent: Adapt explicit host navigation requests to an unsaved-change confirmation with a bounded browser unload warning.
context: No universal interception of router events, browser history or links.
Browser unload prompts may be suppressed and cannot show custom application text reliably.
An already running callback cannot be canceled or undone by unmount.
A retry may invoke onDiscard again; host callbacks must tolerate retries.
